coordinateSystem: Top-left origin. One texture pixel per existing deck logical pixel, nearest-neighbour filtering, no mipmaps. Hull C 426x161; sailor 32 pixels tall.

palette.policy: Every opaque RGB is an exact member of the existing deck/environment palette. No added colours. Runtime opacity interpolation may yield intermediate colours, just as calm sky blending does.
palette.cloudIntegration: Same three-slot format as calm clouds, but storm source slots are the three colours above. Supply these to mask extraction; do not use the calm source-slot RGBs or calm bright daytime tint map. Alternatively draw the storm RGB sprite as-is. Preserve each existing cloud's id, canvas, lane, transform, drift and wrap position.

intensity.meaning: Suggested normalized atmosphere intensity: 0 calm, 1 peak. Integrator maps the dial to this domain; no worker-count formula is imposed by this asset handoff.
intensity.ramp: For each asset, t=clamp((intensity-start)/(full-start),0,1); weight=t*t*(3-2*t)*maxOpacity. Smooth changing intensity over about 2000ms; reverse the same ramp as activity falls.
intensity.calmSeaAndWake: Keep matching calm/storm frame indices on the same shared clock, frameMs=240 and same pace multiplier if one is used. Do not restart either cycle when fading. Sea uses identical drift, origin and clipping on both layers.
intensity.opaqueBlend: Draw calm opaque then storm at weight over the same destination. Overcast sky likewise draws over the existing time-of-day blend.
intensity.transparentBlend: Cloud/wake pairs share canvas and anchor. Prefer linear premultiplied RGBA interpolation in a temporary surface, then composite once, to avoid dark overlap at half intensity. Ordinary opposing sprite opacity ramps are acceptable with a slight midpoint dip. Silhouettes are generated variants, not pixel-identical morph targets.
intensity.reducedMotion: Hold sea/wake frame 0 and freeze cloud drift. Do not fire lightning or animated spray in still/lite modes. Static high-weather appearance can remain.

assets.seamlessConfirmed: All four opposite rows and columns are byte-identical; 2x2 repeat visually inspected. Edge reconciliation is documented in cleanup.json.
assets.mapping: Crossfade matching calm sea frame. Far band begins world y=96; near band y=151 samples row 55. Both bands use x=positiveModulo(worldX-driftX,256), y=positiveModulo(worldY-96,128). Use the calm drift (base 10px/s) on both textures. Do not scale swells separately.
assets.limitation: Broad repeating swells remain recognizable over a large viewport. Generated crest deformation is a four-pose loop, not continuous fluid motion; some foam shimmer at frame changes.

assets.mapping: Crossfade the wisp in place using the existing sky transform, cloud lane and whole-sprite drift. Top-left anchor [0,0]. Same three-slot format; use storm slots above. Isolated sprite, not a repeating tile.
assets.limitation: Low storm scud; intentionally only eight visible logical rows.

assets.mapping: Crossfade calm puff at the same top-left [0,0] anchor, lane and sky transform. Use storm colour slots. Isolated drift sprite; wrap only fully offscreen with existing 32px margin.
assets.limitation: Small lumpy silhouette; no cloud deformation animation.

assets.mapping: Crossfade calm cumulus at the same top-left [0,0] anchor, lane and sky transform. Use storm colour slots. Preserve whole-sprite drift and offscreen wrap; not a tile.
assets.limitation: Central dome becomes broad stepped clusters at native size; no cloud deformation.

assets.mapping: Crossfade calm long-bank at same top-left [0,0] anchor, lane and sky transform. Use storm colour slots. Keep existing drift and offscreen wrap; isolated sprite, not an edge-to-edge cloud strip.
assets.limitation: Heavy scalloped underside reads angular when enlarged; appropriate to the existing pixel scale.

assets.mapping: Crossfade calm twin-bank at same top-left [0,0] anchor, lane and sky transform. Use storm colour slots. Keep existing drift and offscreen wrap; not a tile.
assets.limitation: Twin peaks and long flat base remain visible at enlarged review scale.

assets.mapping: Crossfade matching calm wake frame at fixed stern anchor; do not drift with sea. Above near sea, below hull-contact foam. Opens right/down; preserve the crest knot above waterline. Finite sprite, not seamless/repeating.
assets.limitation: Ready to load and anchored in all phases. Generated interior eddies and far tips morph between phases rather than following ideal downstream flow; a pixel artist could improve in-betweens.

assets.mapping: New small overlay above sea/wake and below crew/UI. At hull contact, place anchor on [68,151] or [392,151] in deck coordinates, matching existing bow/stern water contact. For open-water use, seed an emitter at a visible rough-sea crest and carry it with the sea drift during its 480ms lifetime. Not a full-screen particle field and not a tile. Preserve existing water/foam frames.
assets.limitation: Registered short burst, with slightly changing base curl and droplets. Good at restrained opacity; human in-betweening would improve particle trajectories.

assets.mapping: New distant fork flash above sky/stars but BEHIND storm cloud sprites, gull, ship and sea. Place top endpoint behind a bank's underside using sky-source coordinates; keep lower tip above sky horizon row 213. Does not replace a calm asset, does not brighten the whole screen. Draw once then hide.
assets.limitation: Small stylized distant fork, not realistic sheet-lightning illumination. Suppress entirely under reduced motion.

assets.mapping: Optional overcast crossfade above the current six-phase sky blend but below stars/clouds. Same destination rectangle and skyPlacement transform, source horizon row 213. Existing band/cloud geometry is preserved through sampled generated colour-region mapping. Use maxOpacity 0.7 in day; multiply that by (1-nightWeight) so night does not brighten. Fade stars by the overcast weight if desired. Not tiled.
assets.limitation: A single restrained overcast daylight treatment, not six new weather/time-of-day palettes. Keep underlying night treatment; no rain included.

format: 19 individual lossless indexed PNGs; no duplicate strips or source images in runtime directory. Binary sprite alpha has transparent RGB zero; sea and sky opaque.
integrationStatus: Assets-only handoff. No runtime manifest/schema, loader, renderer, install or PR changes. The companion manifest describes the intended future integration; it is not automatically loaded by the current deck.
